 Alex Eala Hong Kong Tennis Open 2026 
 Hong Kong Tennis Open 2026 
 LIVE UPDATES: Eala seeks HK Open semis spot vs Ruzic 
 DT · 6 November 2026 · 6:33 PM PHT · 4 MIN READ 
 Text size A− Reset A+ Save ERed-hot Alex Eala guns for a seat in the semifinals of Hong Kong Tennis Open as she faces Antonia Ruzic for the first time on Friday evening. 
 Eala took down Australian Emerson Jones in the opening round (6-4, 6-3) and familiar foe Tereza Valentova of Croatia (6-4, 7-6) in the round of 16. 
 Refresh the page for live updates. 
 Set 2 
 Eala on second break point. 
 Ruzic saves two break points. 
 Break point #4 for Eala. 
 Ruzic double fault. Deuce. 
 Eala catches a line, on advantage now. 
 Another break point erased. 
 Eala backhand return goes straight to the net, Ruzic takes first game. 
 Eala leads 40-0. 
 Eala makes it even at 1-all. 
 Eala seeks to break Ruzic, 30-0. 
 Ruzic answers with a down the line forehand, 30-15. 
 Eala on break point. 
 Eala breaks Ruzic, leads 2-1. 
 Eala wide, 30-15 for Ruzic. 
 Ruzic rearing to break Eala. 
 Deuce. 
 Ruzic break point. 
 Ruzic breaks Eala for 2-all card. 
 Ruzic double fault, 15-all. 
 Eala on break point!
 Eala takes the lead, 3-2. 
 Eala slice, 30-0. 
 Eala serves first ace of the match.
 Deuce, the 21st deuce of the game so far. 
 Eala leads 4-2 now. 
 Deuce. 
 Eala aiming to break Ruzic again. 
 Back to deuce after Ruzic sends ball to the net. 
 Ruzic on advantage after an ace. 
 Eala short on the backhand. 
 Ruzic holds, trails 4-3. 
 Eala double fault puts Ruzic on top, 30-15. 
 Ruzic down the line puts Eala on break point. 
 Rain goes down the stadium! Umpire gets down to check the court. 
 Play suspended. Eala leads match at 4-3. 
 Ruzic, Eala hit balls before starting the match again. 
 Ruzic evens match at 4-all. 
 Ruzic rushes to 40-0. 
 Eala return goes wide, Ruzic takes the lead at 5-4. 
 Eala fights back, stays alive, 30-15. 
 Eala on advantage. 
 Eala crawls back from deficit, makes it even at 5-all. 
 Eala on single break point.
 Eala break point. 
 Eala leads 6-5 now. 
 Eala serving for the match. 
 Eala two points away from winning the match. 
 Eala match point! 
 Eala match point #2. 
 Hard fought win for Eala to clinch semis spot in the Hong Kong Tennis Open. 
 Set 1 
 Eala to serve first. 
 Ruzic returns goes straight to the net, 15-0 Eala. 
 Eala backhand return going strong, 30-0. 
 Eala finds a spot and claims first game, 1-0. 
 Eala wide, Ruzic leads 15-0. 
 Ruzic finishes with a crosscourt, 30-0. 
 Ruzic double fault, 30-15. 
 Ruzic quickly makes it even, 1-all. 
 Ruzic return goes straight to net, 15-0. 
 Netball again for Ruzic, 30-0 lead for Eala.
 Eala steps on the pedal for a 2-1 lead. 
 Eala ahead again, 15-0. 
 Ruzic barely hits the mark, 15-all. 
 Ruzic rolls to make it 2-all. 
 Eala forehand picks a corner to blank Ruzic and take 3-2 cushion. 
 Eala aims to break Ruzic, 30-15.
 Ruzic ties it at 3-3. 
 Ruzic two break points. 
 Eala not backing down, hacks out a deuce. 
 Ruzic breaks Eala for 4-3 advantage. 
 Ruzic goes wide, Eala one break point away. 
 Eala breaks Ruzic. 4-all. 
 Ruzic wide, 15-all. 
 Eala backhand goes short, 30-15.
 Eala returns not working well, Ruzic leads 40-15. 
 Ruzic break point #2. 
 Eala fights back, deuce. 
 Ruzic lands a spot, on advantage.
 Ruzic return goes wide, deuce. 
 Eala on advantage. 
 Eala goes long. Deuce. 
 Ruzic reads Eala's drop shot, on advantage now. 
 Eala catches the line, deuce! 
 Eala on advantage. 
 Ruzic fights back, deuce. 
 Eala long, Ruzic on advantage. 
 Eala double fault gives Ruzic 5-4 lead. 
 Ruzic return wide, 30-all.
 Ruzic double fault puts Eala on break point. 
 Eala wide, deuce. 
 Eala on second break point. 
 "Let's go Alex, let's go!" heard from the crowd. 
 Ruzic double fault makes the match even at 5-all. 
 Eala back-to-back shots beyond the line. 
 Ruzic wide, 30-15. 
 Deuce, once again. 
 Ruzic on break point. 
 Ruzic breaks Eala, leads 6-5. 
 Ruzic serving for the set. 
 Eala on the lead. 
 Eala breaks Ruzic to head to the tiebreak! 
 Eala drop shot, 1-0 in the tiebreak.
 Ruzic returns it straight to the net, Eala 2-0. 
 Eala on a 4-0 run. 
 Ruzic fighting back with a 3-0 run of her own, now at 5-3!
 Eala's returns goes sour. 
 Just like a memory of last night's tiebreak against Valentova. Jinx?
 Ruzic double fault sends Eala to set point at 6-4. 
 Eala on set point #2. Ruzic trails by a heartbeat, 6-5. 
 Eala crumbles in the tiebreak as Ruzic makes it 6-all.
 Ruzic on set point after Eala return goes wide. 
 Eala says not yet, leads 8-7 after a drop shot. 
 Eala finally claims the first set after more an hour and 20 minutes of hard-fought battle.
